text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: page fired: p99 latency > 750ms for service=runner-eu-west, threshold=500ms, window=5m
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-87421 created and routed to on-call
jordan: acked INC-87421 :thumbsup: I'm the on-call for eu-west, starting triage
sam: joining — any obvious deploys?
jordan: not that I can see, last deploy 3h ago. metrics show p95 fine, p99 spike.
priya: looking at traces — increased tail on transformer decode hotpath, a few ops show GPU mem pressure in hosts eu-west-3a
alex: fyi I see autoscaler triggering a few scale-ups then throttling; might be hitting quota on ded-pool.
maria: tagging infra: @oncall-rotation can you confirm reserved GPU capacity?
oncall-rotation: we're at 92% reserved capacity in eu-west-dedicated, autoscaler is blocked by quota. opening ticket with cloud console now.
jordan: quick mitigation: can we route traffic to fallback smaller model variant? config path: `routing.policies.fallback_model`
sam: yes we have smaller-quant model: `r/mistral-6b-q8-lite`. I'll push temporary route to 20% traffic. doing `rtctl promote --service runner-eu-west --variant mistral-6b-q8-lite --pct 20`
sam: (runs)```
> rtctl promote --service runner-eu-west --variant mistral-6b-q8-lite --pct 20
Promote started: routing change in 3s
```
priya: dashboards showing immediate drop in p99 by ~200ms after routing partial traffic — good signal
jordan: still seeing some nodes at high GPU mem usage, looks like a hotkey on a few prefixes causing long KV cache growth. any hotkey candidates?
leo: digging logs, found repeated requests for "/chat/complete" with identical long prompt from a single caller IP, ~120 req/min to same shard -> likely a client retry storm or bug.
maria: reaching out to customer success to identify caller (might be partner integration). CS pinged partner and they're investigating.
pagerduty: INC-87421 status: acknowledged (jordan)
jordan: mitigation summary so far: 1) partial traffic reroute to q8-lite variant (20%), 2) autoscaler ticket opened, 3) identified hotkey caller -> throttling rule applied at edge (rate limit 10r/s per IP) 4) kicked KV cache warmup on new nodes
priya: adding command snippets we used:
```
# check busy GPUs
rbctl node-metrics --region eu-west --filter "gpu_mem_used>80"
# apply edge throttle
edgectl rate-limit set --ip 1.2.3.4 --limit 10/s --service runner-eu-west
```
alex: cloud quota team replied, can approve short-term burst to add 2 more dedicated GPUs, requesting manual approval — I've escalated to infra leads.
sam: rolling config to drop long-prefix caching for suspicious prefixes to avoid KV growth, patch pushed.
jordan: customer impact: intermittent increased latency for tail requests; estimated affected traffic ~0.25%-0.6% global, concentrated eu-west; errors remained low (timeouts ~0.01% extra) — CS tracking impacted customers, potential SLA blip.
maria: CS reports partner acknowledged bug on their side, will throttle retries.
leo: logs show p99 trending down now to ~420ms from 980ms at peak.
oncall-rotation: handoff note for next on-call (in 45m): keep fallback routing at 20% until autoscaler quota bump confirmed, monitor p99 and GPU mem, keep edge throttle for identified IP until partner fixes. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-tail-response
jordan: prepping post-incident notes, will add timeline and signal graphs. tagging for postmortem: @priya @sam @alex @maria @leo
pagerduty: INC-87421 updated: acknowledged -> monitoring
incident-bot: auto-close check in 30m if p99 < 500ms for 20m
jordan: thanks team — ending active triage. will update once infra confirms quota increase or until we revert routing. :v:
